companies.name: アメリカン・インターナショナル・グループ

relations.text: AIGから農業保険事業Crop Risk Servicesを買い取った(2023年7月)
relations.text_en: Bought AIG's Crop Risk Services, which took AIG out of crop insurance (July 2023)

source.label: AIG 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 3, 2023, AIG closed the sale of Crop Risk Services, Inc. to American Financial Group, Inc. and in substance, AIG exited the crop business.

companies.name: B.ライリー・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: B. Rileyが10-K/Aで、傘下のGreat American各社(AFG)と新株予約権つきの契約を結んだと記載(2025年4月)
relations.text_en: B. Riley issued warrants to AFG's Great American insurers under an April 2025 agreement

source.label: B. Riley Financial 10-K/A(2025年度)
source.quote: Riley Financial, Inc., and Great American Insurance Company, Great American Contemporary Insurance Company, and National Interstate Insurance Company (collectively "AFG"), dated as of April 7, 2025

relations.text: Skywardが10-Kで、競合の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Skyward names it among its competitors

source.quote: Berkley Corporation; American Financial Group Inc.; Tokio Marine Holdings, Inc.; CNA Financial 16 Table of Contents Corporation; Hiscox, Ltd.; RLI Corp.

companies.name: パロマー・ホールディングス

relations.text: Palomarが10-Kで、連邦農業保険で競合する会社の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Palomar names it a rival in the federal crop insurance market

source.label: Palomar Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we compete with 11 other insurance carriers in the federal crop market, including The Chubb Corporation and American Financial Group, Inc.

relations.text: NI Holdingsが10-Kで、農業保険の主な競合としてGreat Americanを挙げる
relations.text_en: NI Holdings names its Great American unit a principal crop insurance competitor

source.label: NI Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The principal competitors in our markets for multi-peril crop insurance include Chubb, QBE Insurance Group, Zurich, AgriSompo, and Great American Insurance Group.

companies.name: ハミルトン・インシュアランス・グループ

relations.text: Hamiltonが10-Kで、競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Hamilton lists it first among its competitors

source.label: Hamilton Insurance Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of our competitors include American Financial Group, Inc.; Arch Capital Group Ltd; AXIS Capital Holdings Limited; Beazley plc; Cincinnati Financial Corporation; Everest Group, Ltd.
